ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of widespread fraud in Minnesota, including the use of state programs and federal funds
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to determine the full extent of the fraud
questions: What is the full extent of the fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost due to the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and could lead to significant recoveries of lost funds. I recommend starting with a review of state and federal records, and then following up with interviews of key officials and whistleblowers.
